calls.title: bbj-qyey-heq
calls.summary: The team outlined a structured method for creating and distributing license keys, specifically for Bolden, which includes a flexible 20-seat baseline and a four-week trial period set to end on September 7th. Emphasis was placed on secure transmission through encrypted services instead of email, ensuring that the license keys are handled safely. Instructions for installation were defined, allowing admins to enter the license key directly into the Growth Book UI or server environment variables, with a reminder that the Org ID is critical for updates. The trial management process ensures that licenses remain operational post-expiration and provides clarity through a visual countdown. Scott's confirmed access to Retool will allow for timely license updates, while August will be available for immediate support during the onboarding phase.
calls.keywords: license key, Bolden, Retool, trial license, secure delivery, fintech, self-hosted license, Growth Book UI
